_comment: OSM source data of the cloud builder (docs/design/map-hosting.md §Source data). Any cell is built: its extracts are chosen from the Geofabrik index (tools/cloud/osm_sources.py – smallest country leaf containing cell + 5 km, or the leaves of a border cell, merged after the cut). 'sources' are PINNED extracts checked first: a cell whose exact bbox lies inside one of their 'cover' rectangles ([west, south, east, north], conservative) is cut from that extract only (South Tyrol keeps the extract its first cells were built from). Extracts older than max_age_days are downloaded again; at most max_downloads_per_day downloads per day (cost guard: a NEW area beyond it waits, an old extract is used a little longer); extracts above max_extract_mb are refused.
